judgment.notes: M002 is instantiated with A=Q, B=R, source module M_R and the inclusion algebra structure. D007–D008 give the ring/module structures, N002 gives freeness and rank n, and the denominator argument plus finite-dimensional injectivity gives the strong rank conditions. Its conclusion is finrank_Q(Q tensor_R M_R)=n. M001 is instantiated over Q with finite index set I and constant component T=Q tensor_R J. N001 gives |I|=n; F002 gives a finite spanning set, hence a finite basis, of each component. Its conclusion is dim_Q(T^I)=nr. These substitutions match the supplied signatures.
